artworks.title: Interior with Pink Wallpaper II (Interieur aux tentures roses II)
artworks.description: This is a painting of a room with an open door revealing a glimpse of an interior scene. The image is composed of vertical and horizontal color-blocked areas and abstract patterns. The central focus is a doorway that leads to another room with various colored shades like blue, yellow, and red. The foreground has a patterned red and white wall on the left and a series of yellow lines. The composition is a mix of abstract and observational detail with a vibrant color palette.

artworks.title: Interior with Pink Wallpaper III (Interieur aux tentures roses III)
artworks.description: The image shows a combination of vertical and horizontal lines with patterns and shapes filling the entire space. On the left side are vertical rectangular forms and curved shapes in vibrant red, yellow, and blue hues. Towards the center and right, a floral pattern in red and pink against a neutral background is displayed. The abstract piece suggests an interior setting with floral and ornate characteristics.

artworks.title: The Birth of Annette (La naissance d'Annette)
artworks.description: The image shows a partial view of a person's upper body. The person is seated or lying on a surface, likely a bed, facing towards the right. Their face is in profile, with short, dark, and possibly curly hair visible. The individual's features are not distinctly detailed in the image. They are wrapped in a light-colored garment. Surrounding them is a vibrant patterned pillow featuring pink and green designs, and a surface with pastel-striped fabric. In the background, there are muted earthy tones and what appears to be floral patterns or a decorative screen with pinkish and green hues. No jewelry or objects held by the person can be discerned in this view.

artworks.title: Game of Checkers (La partie de dames)
artworks.description: This is a painting of an interior scene with figures playing a checkers or chess game. The setting is cozy with warm colors like burgundy, olive green, and beige. The room has intricate swirling wallpaper. The brushwork is soft and slightly blurred, reminiscent of the style of Édouard Vuillard.

artworks.title: Cover for the Album "Paysages et intérieurs"
artworks.description: This is a painting of an interior scene featuring a woman reading. The work depicts a figure reclining on a surface, possibly a sofa, engrossed in reading a book, with the surroundings arrayed in an artistic and slightly abstract manner. The composition includes varied textures and forms, utilizing a muted palette dominated by greens and browns. A bookshelf and various pieces of furniture are depicted behind the figure, with indistinct forms evocative of domestic objects. Words are integrated into the artwork, giving it a textual and narrative layer.

artworks.title: The Bakery (La patiserie)
artworks.description: This is a painting of a café scene with tables and chairs under striped awnings. The image depicts an abstracted outdoor café or restaurant setting, where several tables are placed under wide striped awnings. The word "TISSERIE" is visible. The composition features bold colors like red, green, and yellow, against a more muted background. There is a play of abstract forms and colors that suggest chairs and possibly objects like vases or lamps on the tables. The style conveys a vibrant, lively setting typical of a café.

artworks.title: La Vie muette
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a theatrical scene or a promotional poster for a play. The image features text detailing the play titled "La Vie Muette" along with information such as the author Maurice Beaubourg and the cast list. The drawing depicts a forest setting with barren trees and two figures. One figure appears to be seated or bent over at the left, while another figure stands in the background on the right. The style of the drawing is sketchy, with loose, expressive lines and a monochromatic palette, giving it an ethereal and somber atmosphere. The text is integrated among the trees, blending the announcement details with the forest scene.

artworks.title: Four Scenes from the First Book of Samuel
artworks.description: This is a painted manuscript page featuring people in robes and cloaks engaged in various actions. The top section shows two kneeling people, a man and a woman, facing the right, towards a bearded man crouching near a tall tower or building. The middle portion is similar, although the two people are standing instead of kneeling, and man seems to hold a child. The bearded man on the right is also standing, but his face and body are obscured by damage to the page. The bottom part shows three smaller people on the left, one of them with a halo, next to a large man lying on the right, wearing armor and a helmet. The paintings are in shades of bright red, blue, pale yellow, and brown. Red text seems to identify the different people and scenes. The pigment has worn away in some places, and text from the other side of the page appears to bleed through into this side.

artworks.title: Saint John Dictating to the Venerable Bede
artworks.medium: pen with brown and red ink with color washes on vellum

artworks.title: Christ on the Cross
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in dark red, blue-green, olive, yellow-brown and blue;  printed in brown ink on two sheets of paper
artworks.dimensions:
Overall: 82.9 x 52.8 cm (32 5/8 x 20 13/16 in.)
overall (external frame dimensions): 92.1 x 64.1 cm (36 1/4 x 25 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a central figure on a cross surrounded by four other figures. The central figure has a halo around their head and appears gaunt with emphasis on ribs and bones. The surrounding figures have halos and are in different standing or kneeling positions. They wear robes with visible folds and are in supportive poses. The background is dark and aged, suggesting an ancient painting.

artworks.title: Woman Reading (Liseuse)
artworks.medium: monotype in black ink on cream laid paper

artworks.title: The Flagellation
artworks.artist: Follower of Master of the Golden Bull
artworks.description: This is a painting of a medieval illuminated manuscript page that includes musical notation and an ornate illustration. The manuscript page features a detailed initial "C" that illustrates a biblical scene in vibrant colors, with a gold background. Surrounding the initial is elaborate floral and vine decoration in a range of colors, extending into the margin. Below this, there are lines of neumes—an early form of musical notation—written in bold black ink on red lines, with the text in the same style. The page has a sophisticated yet delicate appearance, showcasing the artistry and craftsmanship typical of illuminated manuscripts from the medieval period.

artworks.title: Coronation of the Virgin with the Trinity  and Saints
David in Prayer
artworks.artist: Follower of Master of the Golden Bull
artworks.description: This is a painting of an illuminated manuscript page with musical notation. The page features text in Latin with musical notation in black ink on red-ruled staves. The text includes decorative initials in red, and a large ornate initial "L" in the lower portion of the page with a detailed miniature of a figure in a green robe within a gilded background with floral designs. The left margin is adorned with vine-like decorations with foliage and circular motifs.

artworks.title: Isaac Blessing Jacob
artworks.artist: Follower of Master of the Golden Bull
artworks.description: This is a painting of a decorated manuscript page featuring an illuminated initial. The page is part of an illuminated manuscript, showcasing a large, intricately illustrated initial letter. Within this letter, a small scene takes place, surrounded by ornate floral patterns in gold and other vibrant colors. The rest of the page contains musical notations and Gothic script written on a series of horizontal red lines. The decorative elements and style of illumination are reminiscent of the Gothic period, commonly seen in religious texts from the Middle Ages.

artworks.title: The Judge Judah (?)
artworks.description: This is a painting of an illuminated manuscript page. The page features a large initial 'V' with intricate designs in the center-left section. The initial is set against a gold background with red and blue foliage-like decorations. To the left of the initial is a figure draped in robes standing on a green base. The figure is stylized with a halo surrounding the head. The text on the page is written in a medieval Latin script, with the first line highlighted in red. The style is typical of medieval manuscript illumination.

artworks.title: Nuremberg
artworks.description: The image depicts a detailed engraving of a medieval cityscape, showcasing the city of Nuremberg from an elevated point of view. The view encompasses the rooftops, buildings, walls, and towers. The horizon is filled with church spires, towers, and fortifications following the city's layout. The engraving displays intricate detail with fine lines, typical of such artworks. The color palette is monochromatic with sepia tones. A river with a wooden bridge, flanked by paths and rustic structures, is seen in the foreground. The city is densely packed with buildings suggesting a busy urban area. Towered fortifications of the city walls encircle the city in the background.

artworks.title: Adam and Eve
artworks.description: The image depicts two full-length nude figures—a man and a woman—standing in a natural setting. The woman is holding a fruit-like object, with long flowing hair and a focused expression, gazing downward. The man has a bearded face, curly hair, and is reaching his hand around to touch the woman's shoulder. They are surrounded by detailed natural elements like tree trunks and foliage. A serpent coils around a tree trunk to the right, with a sign above the figures reading "Lapsus Humani Generis." The ground is rocky with grass tufts and small animals nearby.

artworks.title: Twelve Children Dancing
artworks.description: Seven cherubic figures dance in a playful manner. The figures have rounded and exaggerated features typical of putti, often used in Renaissance art to symbolize love or playful innocence. The figures are intertwined in a circular formation, some holding objects like an oval frame with branches and leaves. Their expressions vary, with some looking joyfully at each other. Shading and linework give a sense of volume and movement. The scene is dynamic and lively, with some figures turned towards the viewer, creating depth. The drawing has a classical style, emphasizing the human form and natural movement. The piece is signed "Dominicus Caragnola, 1517."

artworks.title: Horses in the Meadow (Chevaux dans la prairie)
artworks.description: This image shows a view of the countryside. The point of view is behind two horses. The horizon line is high, revealing rolling hills and scattered trees. The drawing uses delicate pencil strokes for a soft texture. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of brown. The image conveys a tranquil rural atmosphere with distant silhouettes creating depth.

artworks.title: Landscape with the Cannon
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed print with a high vantage point, depicting a rural landscape. There is a large cannon and figures near a massive tree. A group of elaborately dressed figures are shown nearby. A thatched-roof cottage is partially visible, leading to a village with numerous houses. In the distance, hills with trees and buildings are visible. The print is in monochrome with fine linework and cross-hatching for shadow. The horizon is high, with a darkened sky.

artworks.title: Artus Wolfart
artworks.artist: Cornelis Galle I after Sir Anthony van Dyck
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man from the waist up. The man is positioned with his body facing slightly to the right but his head turned towards the viewer, giving a three-quarter pose. His facial features include a slightly smiling expression with a prominent curled mustache, a short beard, arched eyebrows, and prominent cheekbones. His hair is short, wavy, and neatly styled. He is dressed in a cloak-like garment with a high, ruffled collar, which partly obscures his neck. The material appears to be thick and richly textured. One of his hands is visible and is holding onto the cloak. In the background, there is a textured pattern. The portrait is monochrome and appears to be styled like a traditional engraving or etching. At the bottom of the image, the name "ARTUS WOLFART" is inscribed in uppercase letters.

artworks.title: Constantijn Huygens
artworks.artist: Paulus Pontius after Sir Anthony van Dyck
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man visible from the waist up. He is seated slightly turned to his right and gazes directly at the viewer. His hair is shoulder-length, wavy, and appears loose, framing his face. The man has a mustache and a slight beard below his lower lip. His clothing includes a broad, pleated white collar and a flowing dark garment that drapes over his shoulders and arms. He appears to be holding a book in his left hand, which rests on a surface. The background is a blend of intricately detailed shading with a textured pattern on one side and a depiction of clouds on the other. There are no visible pieces of jewelry.

artworks.title: Karel de Mallery
artworks.artist: Lucas Emil Vorsterman after Sir Anthony van Dyck
artworks.description: The image is a portrait engraving of a man identified as Carolus de Mallery. He is depicted in a three-quarter view, with defined facial features, a short beard, mustache, and medium-length wavy hair. He is wearing a garment with a large ruffled collar, and his right arm is crossed in front of him, holding onto draped fabric. His expression is contemplative as he looks into the distance. There is no visible jewelry, and his left hand is resting on the fabric. The background consists of crosshatched lines and an architectural element, possibly a column, is visible to his right.
